rawInput.file_text:
Proposed Plan: Add deterministic replay fixtures

Problem statement
Add deterministic replay fixtures so test runs can reproduce external inputs and randomized behavior reliably. Fixtures should capture seeds, network responses, DB snapshots, and any non-deterministic inputs, and provide a loader to replay them in CI and locally.

Proposed approach
- Define a compact fixture format: metadata (time, version), RNG seeds, captured network responses, DB state diffs or snapshots, and hooks for custom serializers.
- Implement capture utilities for recording seeds, network, and DB snapshots during an instrumented run.
- Implement a loader that applies seeds, restores DB snapshots, and stubs network responses deterministically.
- Integrate loader into test harness and CI, and provide example fixtures and documentation.

Todos
- design-fixture-format: Define JSON/YAML structure and versioning, serialization rules, and hooks for custom types.
- capture-utils: Implement recorder APIs for RNG seeds, network intercepts, and DB snapshots.
- snapshot-serialization: Implement stable, incremental DB snapshot/diff serialization and restore logic.
- fixture-loader: Build loader that restores seeds, DB, and network stubs for tests and CI.
- test-suite-integration: Wire loader into unit/integration tests and CI pipelines; create end-to-end tests using sample fixtures.
- docs-and-examples: Write usage docs, example fixtures, and migration notes.

Notes and considerations
- Keep fixtures small: prefer diffs and selective capture over full DB dumps.
- Provide opt-in instrumentation to avoid test performance regressions.
- Version fixture format and provide migration helpers.
- Record provenance and checksum for fixture integrity.

Do not implement yet. This file is the plan; await approval to begin implementation.
